verdict.rationale: Dots has its own cloud computer and is documented to implement changes and run builds with permitted developer tools, so it can execute code. It can also delegate work to ChatGPT Work or Codex and read or update Drive documents. None of the evidence covers data analysis, charts, computed answers, or downloadable file outputs, so only the general code-execution core is supported. Missing for 10: documented code execution on user data for analysis, chart generation, downloadable file outputs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
